scenes.say: Meet Help eight six eight. Our support line on WhatsApp, so you can message us any hour of the day.
Ask about your policy, a claim, a payment, or a quote. Update your details. Or ask to talk to a person.
Need a statement, a letter for the embassy, a health claim, or a change of address? Just tap what you need.
It is one tap away. Press the green button on our website, and the chat opens. No app to download, and no forms to fill.
Say hello, and we show you a menu. Tap what you need, answer a couple of questions, and you get a receipt with your reference number and target time.
You are never left wondering. We send you an update every three working days until it is done. Our team follows up Monday to Friday, eight to four.
When it is resolved, you get a short summary. Then you can rate us from one to five stars. If you rate us low, we call you back.
And your privacy matters. In the chat, we never ask for bank details, I D numbers, or passwords.
Help eight six eight. Tap the green button on our website, and say hello.
